parts:
Subject: Let’s connect today + coordinate a full team call

Hi Rudy,

Thank you for the thoughtful note, I really appreciate the transparency.

I’d absolutely love to get a time on the calendar where all four of us can connect, you, Doc, myself, and my business partner Eric. I think that kind of conversation will be the most valuable once we’re aligned and ready to map things out more fully.

That said, I would still really enjoy connecting with you today as planned. It would be helpful to get a clearer picture of what’s currently going on in the practice, especially with the laser being down, and to see where things stand heading into May. I can also answer any immediate questions you have and make sure you’re set up to move quickly once you’re ready.

No pressure at all on timing. I respect that you’re being intentional here, and if May is the right window, we’ll be ready to support you then.

Looking forward to talking with you tomorrow morning.

Warm regards,  
Bethany

Respond to him and let him know that I'd love to set up a time for all four of us to be on the phone, that I'd love to set up a time for all of us to be on the phone including my business partner Eric, But I'd still love to talk to him today and get a little bit better picture of what's going on and see if there's any questions I can answer you:  Hey Bethany,I'd enjoy a follow-up if you'd like at **8am HST Wednesday, April 29**.  However, Doc is not available.  Her email address is carrie@awazul. If you'd like to postpone the call so we can get together as a foursome including Aanchal, I'm totally on board.  I'd rather free up your resource for hotter prospects.  We won't be making a move *this month* but should May be decent and we can get our primary laser fixed that has been out of commission for three weeks, there is a high probability of  May close. 
Either way, I'll be in the office and ready for the call tomorrow.
Warm regards,
Rudy
